grammar: n. 生物学；学科名称通常作不可数名词，不加 a/an 或复数 -s。
collocations: study biology; a biology lesson; biology teacher。
commonMistake: 表示学习这门学科时说 study biology，不说 study a biology。

example.english: We learn about plants in biology.
example.chinese: 我们在生物课上学习植物知识。

application.prompt: In this subject, students learn about plants, animals and the human body. It is ___. A. biology B. history
application.solution: A。解析：研究生物和生命的学科是 biology（生物学）。

grammar: n. information technology（信息技术）的缩写；学科名称常写作大写 IT。
collocations: an IT lesson; study IT; IT teacher。
commonMistake: 学科缩写 IT 要大写；小写 it 通常是代词“它”，词义不同。

example.english: We use computers in our IT lesson.
example.chinese: 我们在信息技术课上使用电脑。

application.prompt: The timetable uses ___ for the subject information technology. A. IT B. it
application.solution: A。解析：information technology 的学科缩写写作大写 IT。

examTags: 阅读·理解地图与地理信息
grammar: n. 地理（学）；通常作不可数名词。表示学科时直接用 geography，不加 a/an。
collocations: study geography; a geography lesson; geography teacher。
commonMistake: geography 表示学科时通常不可数：We have geography today，不说 a geography。

example.english: In geography, we learn about maps and countries.
example.chinese: 地理课上我们学习地图和国家。

application.prompt: Students use maps to learn about countries and places in ___. A. geography B. music
application.solution: A。解析：地图、国家和地方是 geography（地理）的学习内容。

examTags: 阅读·理解过去事件信息
grammar: n. 历史；学科名称通常作不可数名词。the past 指“过去”，history 也可指一段历史或个人经历。
collocations: study history; a history lesson; in history。
commonMistake: 表示学习历史这门学科时通常说 study history，不说 study a history。

example.english: We read about old buildings in history.
example.chinese: 我们在历史课上阅读有关古建筑的内容。

application.prompt: In this subject, we learn what happened in the past. It is ___. A. history B. biology
application.solution: A。解析：研究过去事件的学科是 history（历史）。

examTags: 阅读·判断人物感受与事物特点
grammar: adj. 令人厌烦的；描述引起无聊感的人或事。比较级 more boring，最高级 most boring。
collocations: a boring lesson; a boring book; sound boring。
commonMistake: boring 描述事物“令人无聊”；bored 描述人的感受“感到无聊”。

example.english: The long film is boring, so the children stop watching.
example.chinese: 这部电影很长又无聊，所以孩子们不再看了。

application.prompt: The lesson repeats the same exercise for an hour. It is ___. A. boring B. bored
application.solution: A。解析：lesson 是让人感到无聊的事物，用 boring；人的感受用 bored。

examTags: 词汇·形容词与介词搭配
grammar: adj. 有用的；有帮助的。比较级 more useful，最高级 most useful；常用 be useful for/to。
collocations: a useful book; useful for learning; useful to students。
commonMistake: useful 开头发音是辅音音素 /j/，说 a useful book，不说 an useful book。

example.english: A dictionary is useful for learning new words.
example.chinese: 词典对学习新单词很有用。

application.prompt: This map helps us find the way to the gym. It is ___. A. useful B. useless
application.solution: A。解析：能帮忙找到路线说明地图是 useful（有用的）。

grammar: adj. 令人兴奋的；描述引起兴奋感的人或事。比较级 more exciting，最高级 most exciting。
collocations: an exciting game; an exciting trip; sound exciting。
commonMistake: exciting 描述事物“令人兴奋”；excited 描述人的感受“感到兴奋”。

example.english: The school trip to the museum sounds exciting.
example.chinese: 去博物馆的学校旅行听起来很令人兴奋。

application.prompt: Everyone is looking forward to the school trip. They think it will be ___. A. exciting B. excited
application.solution: A。解析：trip 是令人兴奋的活动，用 exciting；人的感受用 excited。

examTags: 词汇·时间表达与多义词
阅读·定位过去时间信息
grammar: n. 过去；adj. 过去的；prep. 经过、晚于。常见表达 in the past（过去），walk past the school（走过学校）。
collocations: in the past; past events; walk past the library。
commonMistake: past 可作名词、形容词或介词；表示“过去”常说 in the past，不要与动词 pass 混淆。

example.english: In the past, students wrote on a blackboard.
example.chinese: 过去，学生们在黑板上写字。

application.prompt: Our grandparents tell us stories about the ___. A. past B. future
application.solution: A。解析：祖父母讲述以前发生的故事，about the past 表示“关于过去”。

examTags: 听读·获取数字与联系方式
grammar: n. 数字；号码；数量。可数，复数 numbers。表示电话号码常说 phone number；the number of + 复数名词作主语时谓语通常用单数。
collocations: phone number; room number; a large number of books。
commonMistake: number 可表示“号码”或“数量”；a number of 表示“许多”，后接复数名词。

example.english: Please write your phone number on the form.
example.chinese: 请把你的电话号码写在表格上。

application.prompt: The form asks for the digits people can use to call you. Write your phone ___. A. number B. reason
application.solution: A。解析：可用于拨打电话的号码是 phone number。

grammar: n. 原因；理由。可数，复数 reasons；常用 the reason for sth. 或 the reason why ...。
collocations: a good reason; the reason for a choice; for this reason。
commonMistake: reason 是可数名词，单数前通常要有 a/the；常说 the reason for something。

example.english: One reason I like biology is that we learn about animals.
example.chinese: 我喜欢生物的一个原因是我们能学习动物知识。

application.prompt: Why do you like geography? Please give me one ___. A. reason B. number
application.solution: A。解析：回答 why（为什么）时给出一个 reason（原因/理由）。

examTags: 语言运用·提醒与记忆表达
grammar: v. 记得；记住。remember to do 表示记得去做；remember doing 表示记得做过。
collocations: remember a name; remember to bring; remember doing sth.。
commonMistake: remember to do 是“记得要做”；remember doing 是“记得做过”，两种结构意思不同。

example.english: Remember to bring your geography book tomorrow.
example.chinese: 记得明天带上你的地理书。

application.prompt: Please ___ to bring your history book to class tomorrow. A. remember B. remembers
application.solution: A。解析：祈使句用动词原形；remember to bring 表示记得去带。

examTags: 语法·比较结构与身份表达
grammar: prep./conj. 作为；像……一样；当……时等。常见结构 as a student（作为学生）、as ... as（和……一样）。
collocations: as a subject; as a teacher; as ... as; as soon as。
commonMistake: as ... as 中间用形容词或副词原级，如 as useful as；不要把第二个 as 漏掉。

example.english: I study French as an optional subject.
example.chinese: 我把法语作为一门选修课来学习。

application.prompt: My mother works ___ a biology teacher at our school. A. as B. because
application.solution: A。解析：as + 职业表示“作为……”，as a biology teacher 意为“作为一名生物老师”。

grammar: abbr. a.m. 的大写形式，表示午夜到中午之间的时间；常写在具体时间后，如 8 a.m. 或 8 AM。
collocations: 7 AM; 8:30 a.m.; from 9 AM to noon。
commonMistake: AM 表示中午前；具体时刻写在 AM 前，如 9 AM。小写 am 也可能是 be 动词 am，要结合时间数字判断。

example.english: Our first class starts at 8 AM.
example.chinese: 我们的第一节课上午八点开始。

application.prompt: The school bus leaves at 7:15 in the morning. It leaves at 7:15 ___. A. AM B. PM
application.solution: A。解析：早晨、中午之前的时间用 AM（或 a.m.）。

examTags: 听读·辨认下午与晚间时间
grammar: abbr. p.m. 的大写形式，表示中午到午夜之间的时间；常写在具体时间后，如 3 PM 或 8:30 p.m.。
collocations: 2 PM; 6:30 p.m.; from noon to 5 PM。
commonMistake: PM 表示中午之后、午夜之前；12 PM 是中午，12 AM 是午夜。

example.english: The history club meets at 4 PM.
example.chinese: 历史社团下午四点开会。

application.prompt: The school concert begins at 7:00 in the evening. It begins at 7:00 ___. A. AM B. PM
application.solution: B。解析：晚上七点在中午之后、午夜之前，用 PM（或 p.m.）。

examTags: 拼写·专有名词首字母大写
grammar: adj./n. 法国的；法语；法国人。表示语言时通常作不可数名词；语言和国籍名称首字母大写。
collocations: speak French; French food; a French student。
commonMistake: French 作语言或国籍形容词时首字母要大写；说“会说法语”用 speak French，不加 a。

example.english: We learn French on Tuesday afternoon.
example.chinese: 我们周二下午学法语。

application.prompt: Choose the correctly written language name: “I can speak ___.” A. French B. french
application.solution: A。解析：语言名称 French 的首字母要大写。

examTags: 语言运用·表达赞扬与评价
grammar: adj. 极好的；优秀的。可作定语或表语；以元音音素开头，前面的单数名词通常用 an。
collocations: an excellent student; excellent work; be excellent at maths。
commonMistake: excellent 前用 an：an excellent idea；不要因首字母是 e 以外的信息而漏掉冠词。

example.english: You did an excellent job on the geography project.
example.chinese: 你在地理项目中做得非常出色。

application.prompt: Mia gets the top mark on every test. She is ___ student. A. an excellent B. a excellent
application.solution: A。解析：excellent 以元音音素开头，前面用 an。

examTags: 语法知识·可数名词与复数
grammar: 可数名词，表示乐器或工具；复数为 instruments。表示乐器时常用 musical instrument。
collocations: a musical instrument；play an instrument；string instrument
commonMistake: instrument 是乐器/工具；instrumental 是形容词，不能直接替代名词。

example.english: A piano is a musical instrument with black and white keys.
example.chinese: 钢琴是一种有黑白琴键的乐器。

application.prompt: A piano is an example of a musical ___.
application.solution: instrument

grammar: 可数名词，表示歌手；由 sing 加 -er 构成，复数为 singers。sing 的变化是 sing—sang—sung。
collocations: a pop singer；a famous singer；singer and songwriter
commonMistake: singer 是“歌手”，sing 是“唱歌”；注意 sing 的过去式是 sang。

example.english: The young singer practises in the music room after school.
example.chinese: 这位年轻歌手放学后在音乐教室练习。

application.prompt: A person who sings songs for an audience is a ___.
application.solution: singer

examTags: 语法知识·名词与形容词
grammar: 可作名词，表示将来；也可作形容词，表示未来的。谈将来常用 in the future。
collocations: in the future；future plans；future job
commonMistake: 通常说 in the future；表示将来的计划可说 future plans。

example.english: I want to learn more about music in the future.
example.chinese: 我将来想多了解音乐。

application.prompt: The time after the present is the ___.
application.solution: future

examTags: 语言运用·校园时间安排
grammar: 可数名词；在学校语境中表示学期，复数为 terms。
collocations: this term；next term；the autumn term；the term starts/ends
commonMistake: term 在学校语境中指学期；不要与表示某个学科术语的 term 混淆。

example.english: We have a new music teacher this term.
example.chinese: 这学期我们有一位新的音乐老师。

application.prompt: Our autumn ___ ends in January. (term / lesson)
application.solution: term

examTags: 语法知识·可数名词与复数
语言运用·描述困难与解决办法
grammar: 可数名词，表示问题或难题；复数为 problems。
collocations: solve a problem；a maths problem；have a problem with
commonMistake: 表示一个问题时用 a problem；problem 是可数名词，不能直接用单数而不加限定词。

example.english: I ask my teacher when I have a problem with a maths question.
example.chinese: 数学题遇到问题时，我会向老师请教。

application.prompt: I cannot find the answer to this question. I have a ___.
application.solution: problem

examTags: 词汇辨析·名词与形容词
grammar: 可作名词，表示魔法；也可作形容词修饰名词，如 magic show。表示“有魔力的”也常用 magical。
collocations: do magic；a magic trick；a magic show
commonMistake: magic 可作名词或定语形容词；magician 才表示“魔术师”。

example.english: The singer showed us a simple magic trick after the concert.
example.chinese: 演唱会后，这位歌手给我们表演了一个简单的魔术。

application.prompt: A show with surprising tricks may be called a ___ show.
application.solution: magic

examTags: 语法知识·不规则名词复数
语言运用·描述日常与校园
grammar: 名词，可表示生命或生活；作可数名词时复数为 lives，变复数时 f 变为 v 再加 -es。
collocations: school life；family life；daily life；a healthy life
commonMistake: life 的复数是 lives，不是 lifes；注意 lives 也可作动词 live 的第三人称单数。

example.english: School life is busy, but I enjoy my music lessons.
example.chinese: 校园生活很忙碌，但我喜欢音乐课。

application.prompt: The plural form of the noun life is ___.
application.solution: lives

grammar: 可数名词，表示科学家；由 science + -ist 构成，复数为 scientists。
collocations: a scientist；a famous scientist；a team of scientists
commonMistake: scientist 指科学家，science 指科学学科；表示“一位科学家”要用 a scientist。

example.english: The scientist visits our school to talk about space.
example.chinese: 这位科学家来我们学校讲太空。

application.prompt: A person who studies or works in science is a ___.
application.solution: scientist

examTags: 语法知识·可数名词与复数
语言运用·谈论学科偏好
grammar: 可数名词，在学校语境中表示学科；复数为 subjects。也可表示话题或主题。
collocations: school subject；favourite subject；study a subject
commonMistake: subject 表示学科时是可数名词；说“最喜欢的学科”可用 my favourite subject。

example.english: Music is my favourite subject this year.
example.chinese: 音乐是我今年最喜欢的学科。

application.prompt: History and PE are school ___. (subject)
application.solution: subjects

grammar: 动词，表示学习或学会；可接名词、learn to do sth 或 learn about sth。过去式和过去分词可用 learned 或 learnt。
collocations: learn English；learn to play；learn about science；learn from mistakes
commonMistake: learn 表示获得知识或技能；teach 表示把知识或技能教给别人。

example.english: We learn about famous scientists in science class.
example.chinese: 我们在科学课上了解著名的科学家。

application.prompt: At school, we ___ new words and ideas every day. (learn)
application.solution: learn

examTags: 语法知识·学科名称与主谓一致
书写规范·英美拼写差异
grammar: 名词，表示数学学科；英式英语常用 maths，美式英语常用 math；作学科名称时通常使用单数谓语。
collocations: maths lesson；maths teacher；do maths；a maths problem
commonMistake: 英式拼法 maths 末尾有 s，但学科名通常按单数处理，如 Maths is interesting。

example.english: Maths is easier when I draw a picture.
example.chinese: 画图时，我觉得数学更容易。

application.prompt: The school subject about numbers and calculations is ___.
application.solution: maths

grammar: physical education 的缩写，表示体育课/体育；由两个大写字母组成，常见搭配是 PE lesson 或 PE class。
collocations: have PE；a PE lesson；PE teacher
commonMistake: PE 是缩写，两个字母都要大写；表示体育课可说 have PE。

example.english: We play basketball in PE on Thursday.
example.chinese: 我们周四体育课打篮球。

application.prompt: We run, jump, and play sports in ___ class. (PE / art)
application.solution: PE

examTags: 语法知识·形容词与副词
grammar: 可作形容词，表示困难的或坚硬的；也可作副词，表示努力地。harder、hardest 是常见比较级和最高级。
collocations: a hard question；hard work；work hard；try hard
commonMistake: hard 可表示“努力地”；hardly 意为“几乎不”，两者意思不同。

example.english: The last maths problem is hard, but I can try it.
example.chinese: 最后一道数学题很难，但我可以试试。

application.prompt: I need to practise more because this maths problem is ___. (hard / hardly)
application.solution: hard

examTags: 语法知识·形容词与不定式
阅读能力·理解难度描述
grammar: 形容词，表示困难的；常用 be difficult for sb 或 be difficult to do sth；比较级通常用 more difficult。
collocations: a difficult question；difficult for me；difficult to understand
commonMistake: 表示“对某人来说困难”常用 difficult for sb；比较级通常是 more difficult。

example.english: It is difficult to learn a new instrument without practice.
example.chinese: 不练习就很难学会一种新乐器。

application.prompt: This question is not easy to answer. It is ___. (difficult / difficulty)
application.solution: difficult

grammar: 形容词，表示确信的；常用 be sure (that)...、be sure of/about sth 和 make sure。
collocations: Are you sure?；be sure of；make sure；be sure to do sth
commonMistake: 表示“确定……”可说 be sure that...；sure 是形容词，常与 be 连用。

example.english: Are you sure the music lesson is in Room 5?
example.chinese: 你确定音乐课在五号教室吗？

application.prompt: I checked the timetable twice, so I am ___ that PE starts at ten.
application.solution: sure

examTags: 语法知识·形容词与不定式
词汇辨析·形容词与副词
grammar: 形容词，表示容易的；常用 be easy for sb 或 be easy to do；比较级 easier，副词为 easily。
collocations: an easy question；easy to learn；easy for beginners
commonMistake: easy 是形容词，如 The song is easy to learn；easily 是副词，用来修饰动词。

example.english: This song has only three notes, so it is easy to learn.
example.chinese: 这首歌只有三个音符，所以很容易学。

application.prompt: The instructions have one short step, so the task is ___ to finish. (easy / easily)
application.solution: easy

examTags: 语法·不定式与用途表达
grammar: use 可作动词“使用”或名词“用途、使用”；作动词时常用 use sth to do sth，也可用 be used for + 名词/动名词表示用途。
collocations: use a computer; use sth to do sth; be used for; make use of
commonMistake: 表示用某物做某事常说 use sth to do sth；表示用途时也可说 be used for + 名词或动名词。

example.english: We use coloured paper to make a poster for our class.
example.chinese: 我们用彩纸为班级制作海报。

application.prompt: 选词填空：We use a ruler ___ draw straight lines. A. to  B. at
application.solution: A. to。use sth to do sth 表示“用某物做某事”。

grammar: give 是动词，过去式 gave，过去分词 given。常见结构有 give sb sth 和 give sth to sb，表示“给某人某物”。
collocations: give sb a song; give sth to sb; give someone an idea; give a present
commonMistake: give 的过去式是 gave、过去分词是 given；常见双宾语顺序是 give sb sth，或 give sth to sb。

example.english: Our music teacher gives us a new song to practise each week.
example.chinese: 我们的音乐老师每周给我们一首新歌练习。

application.prompt: 选词填空：The teacher gave ___ a new song to practise. A. us  B. to us
application.solution: A. us。句中采用 give sb sth 结构，直接宾语 a new song 放在后面。

grammar: idea 是可数名词，表示“想法、主意”；复数为 ideas。常用 have/get an idea 或 an idea for sth。
collocations: a good idea; have an idea; an idea for a song; an idea to do sth
commonMistake: idea 是可数名词，单数前通常需要 a/an/the 等限定词；idea 以元音音素开头，通常说 an idea。

example.english: I have an idea for our school song.
example.chinese: 我有一个创作校歌的想法。

application.prompt: 选词填空：“Let's write a song about our school.” “That's a great ___!” A. idea  B. afternoon
application.solution: A. idea。对建议表示赞同时可说 That's a great idea!。

grammar: listen 是不及物动词，表示“听”；后接听的对象时通常用 listen to sb/sth。
collocations: listen to music; listen to the teacher; listen carefully; listen for a song
commonMistake: 表示“听音乐/听老师讲”要说 listen to music/the teacher；listen 后接对象时不能漏掉 to。

example.english: We listen to a new song in music class.
example.chinese: 我们在音乐课上听一首新歌。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Please listen ___ the teacher's instructions. A. to  B. at
application.solution: A. to。listen to sb/sth 表示“听某人/某事”。

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: Listen, listen to, or hear?

grammar: draw 是动词，表示“画”；过去式 drew，过去分词 drawn。常用 draw a picture/map，表示画一幅图/地图。
collocations: draw a picture; draw a map; draw a line; draw with a pencil
commonMistake: draw 的过去式是 drew，过去分词是 drawn，不是 drawed；用铅笔画可说 draw with a pencil。

example.english: Lena draws a picture of the school garden after class.
example.chinese: 下课后莉娜画了一幅校园花园的图。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Yesterday, Kate ___ a picture of our classroom. A. drew  B. draw
application.solution: A. drew。Yesterday 表示过去，draw 的过去式是 drew。

examTags: 语法·情态动词后动词原形
grammar: travel 可作动词“旅行、出行”，也可作不可数名词“旅行”；过去式和过去分词通常为 travelled（英式）或 traveled（美式）。
collocations: travel by bus/train; travel to a city; travel around the world; travel abroad
commonMistake: 表示乘坐交通工具出行可说 travel by train；travel 作“旅行”活动时通常不可数，不说 a travel。

example.english: My family likes to travel by train in the summer.
example.chinese: 我家人喜欢在夏天乘火车旅行。

application.prompt: 选词填空：My family will ___ to Beijing by train during the holiday. A. travel  B. travels
application.solution: A. travel。will 后接动词原形。

grammar: walk 可作动词“步行”或名词“散步、步行”；过去式和过去分词均为 walked。常用 walk to school 和 go for a walk。
collocations: walk to school; walk home; go for a walk; take a walk
commonMistake: 表示“步行去学校”说 walk to school；表示“步行回家”说 walk home，home 前通常不加 to。

example.english: We walk to the music room after lunch.
example.chinese: 午饭后我们步行去音乐教室。

application.prompt: 选词填空：We ___ to school every day because we live nearby. A. walk  B. walks
application.solution: A. walk。主语 We 是复数人称，谓语用 walk。

grammar: afternoon 是可数名词，表示“下午”；常见表达为 in the afternoon、this afternoon、on Friday afternoon。
collocations: in the afternoon; this afternoon; tomorrow afternoon; Friday afternoon
commonMistake: 泛指“在下午”常说 in the afternoon；this afternoon 或 tomorrow afternoon 前通常不加 in/the。

example.english: We have music class in the afternoon.
example.chinese: 我们下午有音乐课。

application.prompt: 选词填空：We have art class ___ the afternoon. A. in  B. at
application.solution: A. in。表示“在下午”用 in the afternoon。

grammar: then 是副词，可表示“然后、接着”或“那时”。叙述步骤时常用 first..., then... 表示先后顺序。
collocations: first ... then ...; and then; from then on; by then
commonMistake: then 表示“然后/那时”；than 用于比较，如 taller than me，两词拼写和用法不同。

example.english: First we listen to the song, and then we sing it together.
example.chinese: 我们先听这首歌，然后一起唱。

application.prompt: 选词填空：First, finish your homework; ___, you can listen to the song. A. then  B. before
application.solution: A. then。句意是先完成作业，接着可以听歌，用 then 表示“然后”。

examTags: 写作·称呼格式与大小写
grammar: Miss 可作女性称谓，放在姓名前，如 Miss Green；作为称谓时首字母大写。与 Mr、Ms 一样，后面接姓氏或全名。
collocations: Miss Green; Miss Li; Dear Miss Brown; ask Miss Smith
commonMistake: 作为姓名前的称谓时写作 Miss + 姓氏并大写首字母；不要把 Miss 当作普通名词随意小写。

example.english: Miss Green teaches us music on Tuesday.
example.chinese: 格林老师星期二教我们音乐。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Our female teacher's surname is Green. We call her ___. A. Miss Green  B. Mr Green
application.solution: A. Miss Green。Miss 是女性称谓，Mr 是男性称谓。

examTags: 词性辨析·动词与不可数名词
grammar: work 可作动词“工作、学习、运转”，也可作名词“工作、功课”。表示工作或功课时通常为不可数名词；作动词时常用 work at/in/for。
collocations: do work; a lot of work; work hard; work at a school; work for a company
commonMistake: work 表示一般的工作或功课时通常不可数，不说 a work 或 works；表示一份具体职位常用 a job。

example.english: I have a lot of schoolwork to finish this afternoon.
example.chinese: 今天下午我有很多学校作业要完成。

application.prompt: 选词填空：There is a lot of ___ to do before the school show. A. work  B. works
application.solution: A. work。此处指要完成的工作，是不可数名词，不加复数 -s。

grammar: sometimes 是频度副词，表示“有时”；可放在句首、句中或句末，常放在实义动词前、be 动词后。
collocations: sometimes listen to music; sometimes after school; sometimes ... sometimes ...
commonMistake: sometimes 表示“有时”；sometime 表示“某个时候”，不能混用。

example.english: I sometimes draw pictures after school.
example.chinese: 我有时放学后画画。

application.prompt: 选词填空：I ___ draw after school, but not every day. A. sometimes  B. always
application.solution: A. sometimes。not every day 表示并非每天，符合“有时”。

grammar: feel 可表示“感觉、觉得、摸起来”；过去式和过去分词均为 felt。表示感受时可作系动词，后接形容词。
collocations: feel happy; feel tired; feel well; feel like doing sth
commonMistake: feel 作系动词后接形容词，如 feel tired，不用副词 tiredly；feel 的过去式是 felt。

example.english: I feel happy when we sing together.
example.chinese: 我们一起唱歌时我感到开心。

application.prompt: 选词填空：After the long walk, I ___ tired. A. feel  B. feels
application.solution: A. feel。主语 I 对应动词原形 feel。

examTags: 语法·形容词搭配与不定式
grammar: busy 是形容词，表示“忙碌的、繁忙的”；常用 be busy with sth、be busy doing sth，也可用 too busy to do sth。
collocations: be busy with homework; be busy doing sth; a busy afternoon; too busy to do sth
commonMistake: 常说 be busy doing sth 或 be busy with sth；表示“太忙而不能做某事”用 too busy to do sth。

example.english: The students are busy practising the school song.
example.chinese: 学生们正忙着练习校歌。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Everyone is preparing for the show, so the classroom is ___. A. busy  B. busily
application.solution: A. busy。be 动词后用形容词 busy 作表语。

grammar: study 可作动词“学习、研究”或名词“学习、书房”；动词第三人称单数为 studies，过去式为 studied。常用 study a subject 和 study for a test。
collocations: study English; study for a test; study hard; a quiet place to study
commonMistake: study 以辅音字母 + y 结尾，第三人称单数变 y 为 i 加 -es（studies），过去式变 y 为 i 加 -ed（studied）。

example.english: I study English for thirty minutes after school.
example.chinese: 我放学后学英语三十分钟。

application.prompt: 选词填空：I ___ English every afternoon for the test. A. study  B. studies
application.solution: A. study。主语 I 对应动词原形 study。

grammar: song 是可数名词，表示“歌曲”；复数为 songs。song 也可在固定表达中表示鸟鸣或泛指歌唱。
collocations: sing a song; listen to a song; a school song; a song about school
commonMistake: 表示一首歌曲时 song 是可数名词，单数前通常用 a/the/物主限定词；多首歌用 songs。

example.english: Our class sings a song about school at the show.
example.chinese: 演出时我们班唱了一首关于学校的歌。

application.prompt: 选词填空：The music teacher teaches us a new ___ today. A. song  B. songs
application.solution: A. song。a 后接可数名词单数。

examTags: 语法·副词与 out of 搭配
grammar: out 可作副词或介词，常表示“向外、在外面”；be out 可表示“不在家/不在某处”，表示从里面出来常用 go/come out of + 地点。
collocations: go out; come out; be out; go out of the room; get out
commonMistake: out 表示“不在家/不在某处”时可单独使用；out of 后面通常要接地点或其他名词，如 out of the room。

example.english: Let's go out for a walk after the music lesson.
example.chinese: 音乐课后我们出去散散步吧。

application.prompt: 选词填空：I called Lily at home, but she isn't there; she's ___. A. out  B. out of
application.solution: A. out。表示人不在家可用 be out；out of 后还需要接地点或名词。
